title: EUROTTER: collaborative science for spatial animal ecology
descr: EUROTTER is a European network dedicated to the Eurasian otter (Lutra lutra). It first brings together wildlife managers, field naturalists and researchers working on the species' spatial ecology using telemetry data. By pooling tracking datasets and expertise from across Europe, the network aims to improve our understanding of otter movements, habitat use and home-range dynamics across contrasting landscapes. Eurotter is then meant to grow beyond telemetry and become a broader forum for all questions related to otter management and conservation. Its approach is data-driven and evidence-based. Its goal is to federate research on the species and build collaborative projects at the European scale, to answer questions that cannot be addressed within a single study site.
